name: 7-Eleven Fresh Food Production & Distribution Eden Prairie MN (E.A. Sween)

fieldNotes.truckGate: No controlled truck entrance. Both dock entrances open directly off the W 78th St frontage road with no barrier arm, sliding/swing gate, or checkpoint pinch-point. Street View (2025-04) at the east dock face shows box trucks and trailers backing straight to the docks from an open street-side apron.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No staffed booth at any entrance. The only road-side small structure is a passenger bus shelter at the office front, not a guard booth.
fieldNotes.remoteGs: False because there is no truck gate at all (no gate => not a remote/kiosk-controlled gate).
fieldNotes.postGateStaging: Paved holding area inside the dock entrance between the frontage road and the dock doors where arriving trucks can stage.
fieldNotes.drivewayShort: Open dock aprons sit immediately off the public road; the approach holds only 1-2 trucks before the dock face.
fieldNotes.entryExitTogether: Trucks use the same open driveways to enter and leave; no separate in/out gates.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: 25-50 band. Counted ~8-10 doors on the east road-facing brick dock bank, ~4-6 at the west secondary building (red overhead door), and ~10-15 more along the production building's west/north faces with trailers backed in. ~30 total is an estimate from overhead imagery.
fieldNotes.dropArea: 10-25 band. Rows of parked trailers without tractors in the central/NW staging yard; exact stall count uncertain from overhead.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Two distinct dock clusters on different building faces/buildings (east production dock bank vs. the west secondary warehouse dock), consistent with separate ship/receive flows.
fieldNotes.multipleFacilities: Campus of 3 connected/adjacent E.A. Sween buildings: the east brick production/distribution building, a connected/adjacent warehouse section, and the west secondary warehouse (red dock door) serving the trailer drop yard.
fieldNotes.dropYard: Dedicated trailer-storage rows in the central and NW paved lots, separate from active dock staging.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Urban - inside the Eden Prairie / SW Twin Cities metro fabric, dense commercial/industrial surroundings, adjacent multifamily and offices, on US-212 (Flying Cloud Dr).
fieldNotes.truckGateCount: Two open truck access points: the east dock entrance off the frontage road and the west yard/dock access; neither is gated.
fieldNotes.siteAreaAcres: ~13.7 acres for the traced E.A. Sween operational footprint (production building + warehouse + trailer yard + truck-side parking); excludes neighboring tenants (K.R. Stokes etc.).
fieldNotes.railServed: No rail spur enters the property.

citations.claim: E.A. Sween Company HQ at 16101 W 78th St, Eden Prairie MN 55344
E.A. Sween Company is a current FSIS/USDA-inspected establishment (active food production)

verification.rationale: E.A. Sween Eden Prairie campus at 16101 W 78th St is HQ + USDA-inspected fresh-food production/distribution (~1.2M sandwiches/wk); E.A. Sween is the 3PL producing 7-Eleven fresh food; currently operating.
